item.title: TP-Link TL-WR840N IPv6 WAN Address Command Injection (CVE-2022-25064)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — network · CVE-2022-25064. Status: PoC (complete three-command injection chain implemented, but the script has a malformed Content-Length header and publishes no verification of a successful run). Affects: TP-Link TL-WR840N(ES) V6.20 wireless router firmware, through the IPv6 WAN configuration handled by oal_wan6_setIpAddr. Tags: command-injection, tp-link, tl-wr840n, embedded-router, mips-little-endian, tftp, ipv6, backticks, authenticated, cwe-78.
